entities.summary: Torisesan "Tosan" Evbuomwan is a British professional basketball player for the Charlotte Hornets of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Greensboro Swarm of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Princeton Tigers.
